#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

class NumberTheory {
public:
    class Modulus {
    public:
        virtual long long modulus() const = 0;

        long long fInv(int n) {
            // Placeholder for inverse factorial precomputation if needed
            // For simplicity, assume small n and compute modular inverse directly
            return smallInv(n);
        }

        long long mult(long long a, long long b) const {
            return (a % modulus() * b % modulus()) % modulus();
        }

        long long add(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long res = a + b;
            if (res >= modulus()) res -= modulus();
            return res;
        }

        long long subtract(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long res = a - b;
            if (res < 0) res += modulus();
            return res;
        }

        long long ncr(int n, int r) {
            if (r > n || r < 0) return 0;
            long long res = 1;
            for (int i = 1; i <= r; ++i) {
                res = mult(res, n - i + 1);
                res = mult(res, smallInv(i));
            }
            return res;
        }

        long long smallInv(int n) {
            // Compute modular inverse using Fermat's little theorem
            return powMod(n, modulus() - 2);
        }

    protected:
        long long powMod(long long base, long long exp) const {
            long long result = 1;
            long long b = base % modulus();
            long long e = exp;
            while (e > 0) {
                if (e & 1) result = (result * b) % modulus();
                b = (b * b) % modulus();
                e >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }
    };

    class Mod998 : public Modulus {
    public:
        long long modulus() const override {
            return 998244353LL;
        }
    };
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    NumberTheory::Mod998 mod;
    mod.fInv(n + m);

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; ++i) {
        p = mod.mult(p, n - i);
        p = mod.mult(p, mod.smallInv(n + m - i));
        phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, p);
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
        long long numPhases = mod.mult(m + k, mod.smallInv(k));
        long long e = mod.mult(numPhases, phaseSize);
        long long term = mod.mult(mod.ncr(n, k), e);
        if (k % 2 == 1)
            answer = mod.add(answer, term);
        else
            answer = mod.subtract(answer, term);
    }

    cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
